people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
translations.bsb: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. “Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women,” he commanded.
translations.kjv: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
translations.asv: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
